source.description: Seven quote spans remain derived annotations. Four single raised apostrophe strokes are source ink in the correct 2400×3600 LP2 image scans 21,38,52,58.jpg. The old negative report examined misnumbered scan basenames then counted only ordinary square dots; the source image has four distinct 12×40 pixel high strokes at the listed positions. The independent October 2026 pnotisdev image-gap audit also recorded those four source single ticks. Their plaintext meaning and whether they indicate an additional word boundary remain unknown.
source.solved_lp1_apostrophe_control: The original first-release LP1 p14 Koan (14.jpg) visibly prints a 12x40 tall ink apostrophe at x1051,y2122 inside ciphertext RWN'B, paired with independently known plaintext DON'T. Its same-line square word dot x1114,y2151 is 10x9. SFT sims/lp2_apostrophe_original_pixel_geometry_sft.py confirms this source positive control and four LP2 marks.

known_plaintext_positive_control.cipher_test: Exact 5-rune GP29 differences spell FIRFU, the first five consecutive symbols of the authentic LP1 Koan's 13-rune key, so the punctuation mark does not advance the runic key clock.

coordinate_rule: Zero-based global rune offsets over the 12,956 unsolved LP2 runes, [start,end) interval. page_slices refer to original physical LP2 page numbers; numeric-only page 50 has no runes and remains a physical page. Quotation glyphs are absent from resources/lp2-transcription.txt. The four legacy apostrophe offsets are retained only to reproduce historical experiments and are not source-visible separators. The four raised single apostrophe marks occur immediately before the recorded rune inside a complete printed word; they consume no rune and do not count as additional word separators.

legacy_apostrophe_hypothesis.status: The historical image-negative claim is superseded by a correct LP2-page-to-JPEG scan mapping and confirmed source-visible single ticks. The proposed splitting into extra whole words remains disallowed; apostrophes mark internal morphology only.

apostrophes_before_rune_status: Four confirmed original-image single-tick apostrophes. They are punctuation within existing printed words, while plaintext letters and decryption remain unknown.
